about.title: Where Deen Meets <emphasis>Excellence</emphasis>
about.description: We connect Muslims worldwide through meaningful conversations, authentic knowledge, and a supportive community. Deen Bridge helps people learn, share, and grow in faith through trusted resources, inspiring books, and opportunities to connect.

cta.title: Ready to Join Deen Bridge?
cta.description: Unlock a world of knowledge, community, and growth. Sign up and start your journey today!

features.title: Why Deen Bridge?
features.trustedDescription: Access authentic knowledge curated by scholars and trusted sources.
features.communityDescription: Connect with Muslims worldwide in a safe, welcoming environment.
features.spacesDescription: Join live sessions, discussions, and events that educate and unite the Ummah.
features.learningDescription: Discover books, courses, and resources for your spiritual journey.
features.privacyDescription: Your data and conversations are protected with strong security and privacy standards.
features.excellenceDescription: A platform built for beauty, ease, and spiritual excellence.

stats.title: Learning without borders
stats.description: Open infrastructure makes authentic Islamic education available to everyone.
stats.paymentsDescription: You sign every transaction in your own wallet—we never hold your funds.
stats.feesDescription: Near-zero Stellar fees make learning accessible worldwide.
stats.settlementDescription: Educators receive USDC in seconds, not weeks.
stats.servicesDescription: Web app, API, and AI—all MIT-licensed and built in the open.

footer.description: Deen Bridge connects learners and educators in a vibrant, supportive community. Explore courses, resources, and events that help you grow in knowledge and faith.
footer.communityDescription: Deen Bridge is open source and built in public on the Stellar network. Follow our journey or contribute on GitHub.
